§ 105-64.301 Under what conditions will I be denied access to a record?
The system manager will deny access to a record that is being compiled in the reasonable anticipation of a civil action or proceeding or to records that are specifically exempted from disclosure by GSA in its system of records notices, published in the 
Federal Register.
